Audience: first-time Missouri Class F applicants, from teens on an instruction permit to adult newcomers, who will also face the road sign part of the examination.
Why it matters to a first-timer: default speed limits and the interstate minimum [A02] and the railroad stopping duties [A03] are stated as exact rules that are easy to test.
Level: recognition and recall with exact speeds and distances; moderate load.
Prerequisites: part one of this chapter on sign shapes, colors and signals.
